Exercise: Barbell Hack Squat

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- unilateral_lower_body

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:

- calves
- forearms
- hamstrings

Equipment:

- barbell

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- quadriceps_strength_and_hypertrophy
- hamstring_activation
- calves_engagement

Contraindications:

- Recent knee surgery or injury
- Severe osteoarthritis in the knees

Exercise Variations:

- name: Barbell Hack Squat with Pause, instructions: ['Perform the hack squat as usual, but pause at the bottom for a count of two before returning to the starting position.']
- name: Barbell Hack Squat with Resistance Bands, equipment: resistance bands

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Goblet Squat, equipment: dumbbell
- exercise_name: Split Squat, equipment: barbell or dumbbells

Instructions:

- Stand up straight while holding a barbell behind you at arms length and your feet at shoulder width. Tip: A shoulder width grip is best with the palms of your hands facing back. You can use wrist wraps for this exercise for a better grip. This will be your starting position.
- While keeping your head and eyes up and back straight, squat until your upper thighs are parallel to the floor. Breathe in as you slowly go down.
- Pressing mainly with the heel of the foot and squeezing the thighs, go back up as you breathe out.
- Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
